team.name: Adam Hannay
team.bio: Adam has spent the better part of a decade with his hands on a jigger, his eyes on the guest, and his mind on what makes a great drink truly great. A working bartender, certified spirits educator, and hospitality trainer, Adam built Fish With Legs as a place where the craft could breathe — somewhere between the recipe and the philosophy, the technique and the instinct.

team.name: Mrs Whistledown
team.bio: A certified sommelier and spirits educator, Mrs Whistledown designs the training programmes that sit at the heart of what we do — blending technical precision with real-world bar craft.

team.name: Totoro
team.bio: Totoro brings a chef's sensibility to cocktail creation. His seasonal menus draw on foraged ingredients, fermentation, and a relentless curiosity for flavour.

values.label: Craft
values.desc: Every recipe, technique, and course is built with care and intention.

values.label: Development
values.desc: From your first pour to running your own bar programme, we're here to support every stage of your professional journey.
